- Blue cross at (24, 33) - covering 1 blue dot (the one at row 24, col 33... but wait, blue dots are at (16, 48), (24, 40), (24, 53), (35, 48))

The game says "game is over" but level not completed. Maybe I need to cover ALL blue dots (4 of them) to complete.
From (24, 33), I need to get to (24, 48) to cover all 4 blue dots:
- RIGHT 5: (24, 33+15) = (24, 48)
Let me try this. But first, let me check if the game is actually over or just the level.
